summary: The old harness cannot exercise DTD validation. It also cannot exercise the new combination of DTD validation with XML_PARSE_NO_XXE. XML_PARSE_NO_XXE alone remains selectable. Full coverage is unproven.

claims.necessity_reason: DTD validation is a supported XML parser option, and the complete entry clears its bit before every parser route. An input document with an internal DTD is feasible, but validation through this option is unreachable.

before.requirement: Permit XML_PARSE_DTDVALID when parsing XML so the document can be validated against its DTD.
before.reason: The source derives the context's validation state from XML_PARSE_DTDVALID. The old harness clears that bit before parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The option setter accepts DTDVALID and sets ctxt->validate from that bit.
The pull parser applies its supplied options before parsing.

after.requirement: Permit XML_PARSE_DTDVALID when parsing XML so the document can be validated against its DTD.
after.reason: The source still derives validation state from XML_PARSE_DTDVALID, and the same harness still clears that bit.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The option setter still accepts DTDVALID and sets ctxt->validate from it.
The pull parser applies its supplied options before parsing.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The push route receives the same masked options.
The reader route receives the same masked options.
Input entity pairs supply the main XML document.

claims.comparison_reason: Both source versions support validation through the same option, and the fixed harness removes that option on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: The after source supports DTD validation while XML_PARSE_NO_XXE disables external DTD and entity loading. The old harness can select NO_XXE but always clears DTDVALID, so it cannot reach this combined behavior with an internal DTD.

before.requirement: Validate an XML document while selecting XML_PARSE_NO_XXE to disable external content loading.
before.reason: The before parser option enum has no XML_PARSE_NO_XXE option.

after.requirement: Validate an XML document with XML_PARSE_DTDVALID while XML_PARSE_NO_XXE prevents external DTD and entity loading.
after.reason: The new option is accepted and guards external loading, while DTDVALID still controls validation. The harness removes DTDVALID from every input selected option value.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The new option is defined as bit 23.
The setter accepts both options and derives validation state from DTDVALID.
NO_XXE guards external general entity parsing.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The push route receives the masked options.
The reader route receives the masked options.
Four input bytes can select both option bits before the harness mask.

claims.comparison_reason: The combined option behavior exists only after the change. The fixed harness can retain NO_XXE but removes the validation bit required for this tuple.

claims.necessity_reason: The input's four option bytes can set NO_XXE bit 23. The harness mask leaves that bit intact, and the pull parser applies the resulting options.

before.requirement: Select XML_PARSE_NO_XXE to suppress external content loading.
before.reason: The before option enum does not define XML_PARSE_NO_XXE.

after.requirement: Select XML_PARSE_NO_XXE during XML parsing to suppress external DTD and entity loading.
after.reason: Bit 23 survives the harness mask, is accepted by the parser option setter, and is tested by the external content guards.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser retains NO_XXE in its options.
The pull parser applies the supplied options.
The external subset path tests NO_XXE.
The external parameter entity content path tests NO_XXE.
The external general entity path tests NO_XXE.
The external parameter entity input path tests NO_XXE.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The option reader assembles four input bytes.

claims.comparison_reason: NO_XXE is absent before and directly selectable by the old harness after the change.

missing_information: The supplied packet does not include the bodies of xmlCtxtUseOptions, xmlCreatePushParserCtxt, xmlReaderForMemory, or xmlFuzzEntityLoader. Their option, initialization, and entity resolution paths prevent an affirmative audit of every target route.
The Autoconf defaults in configure.ac are not supplied, so the build and feature configuration cannot be completely certified.
